Name: Tool Hotkeys - One Key One Tool
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[color=#e06666][size=5][font=Courier New][b]Description[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[b][size=4]Tool Hotkeys — One Key, One Tool[/size][/b]
[size=4]Take your weeding, for example. With auto-tool mods, the tool you expect doesn't always come out — but with this mod, the key you set will always bring out your Scythe. You don't need to assign every tool. Just pick the one or two tools you use most, and make them your own.[/size]



[b][color=#e06666][size=5][font=Courier New]Main features[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[size=4][b]How it works[/b]
Assign a key to each tool, then press it to instantly equip that tool. [/size]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b][u]All keys can be freely changed through GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu).[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]
Default keys:
Axe → U[/size]
[size=4]Pickaxe → I[/size]
[size=4]Hoe → O[/size]
[size=4]Watering Can → P[/size]
[size=4]Sword → J[/size]
[size=4]Fishing Rod → K[/size]
[size=4]Scythe → L[/size]
[size=4]
[b]A recommended way to use it[/b]
You don't have to set them all. Just decide on the one or two tools you reach for most. For controller players, pairing this with your Steam button configuration makes it even smoother.[/size]



[b][color=#e06666][size=5][font=Courier New]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=4](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the keys in-game.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and unzip it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Place the[/size]

[code][Yuzu] ToolHotKeys[/code][size=4]folder into your[/size]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][size=4]folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list]
